title: Hold an RSE licence to act as a super fund trustee
what: A trustee of a registrable superannuation entity must hold an RSE licence from APRA.

sources.title: Superannuation Industry (Supervision) Act 1993
sources.quote: (1) A person must not be a trustee, or act as a trustee, of a registrable superannuation entity unless at least one of the following paragraphs apply: (a) the person holds an RSE licence that enables the person to be the trustee of the entity;

assessment.summary: An RSE licence from APRA, with fit and proper, resourcing and governance requirements, before acting as trustee.

marks.reason: A licence with fitness, propriety and resourcing tests is needed before acting as trustee.
